ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced animus cairns
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to craft basic animus cairns from stone, jade, and anima grass. Animus cairns connect to anima trees, and empower those who meditate at that tree.

ResearchProjectDef.label: master animus cairns
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to craft advanced animus cairns from stone, jade, and anima grass. Animus cairns connect to anima trees, and empower those who meditate at that tree.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced animus totems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to craft basic animus totems from stone, jade, and anima sap. Animus totems link to anima trees, and provide powerful map- or even world-wide benefits. They must be fueled with anima grass in order to function.

ResearchProjectDef.label: master animus totems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to craft advanced animus totems from stone, jade, and anima sap. Animus totems link to anima trees, and provide powerful map- or even world-wide benefits. They must be fueled with anima grass in order to function.
